title: Iterators and generators
summary: Process large inputs lazily when you do not need the entire collection in memory at once.

blocks.text: Process large inputs lazily when you do not need the entire collection in memory at once.

items: An iterable can create an iterator; an iterator yields one value at a time.
A generator function uses yield and resumes from its previous state.
Lazy iteration reduces peak memory but does not automatically make CPU work faster.
Materialize with list(...) only when you really need random access or repeated traversal.
